title: Drift suite
purpose: Assert the decoder's declared member, enum, pattern, ordering-key, minimum, and numeric-range tables equal the committed plan schema, the closed $defs/digest sub-schema equals the embedded-digest rule, and the plan version, domain separator, fixture goldens, and Profile forms are pinned.
errors: assertion failure on a table or golden mismatch
invariants: drift is never resolved in favour of the implementation

unit_cases.stimulus: compare the decoder's required-member set and closed-object flags
unit_cases.expected: sorted 16-member set, additionalProperties==false, closed $defs equal the schema (T20-DRF-01)

unit_cases.precondition: every closed enum in the schema
unit_cases.stimulus: probe each member and one out-of-vocabulary token
unit_cases.expected: decoder vocabulary equals each schema enum (T20-DRF-02)

unit_cases.stimulus: probe a conforming and a non-conforming value per pattern
unit_cases.expected: patterns equal the schema; non-conforming rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE (T20-DRF-03)

unit_cases.precondition: the declared collection ordering keys, uniqueItems, and minItems
unit_cases.stimulus: compare the decoder tables with the schema

unit_cases.expected: ranges equal the schema; out-of-range/non-integer rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE (T20-DRF-05)

unit_cases.precondition: the closed $defs/digest sub-schema for every embedded digest
unit_cases.stimulus: compare with the decoder rule and violate a digest
unit_cases.expected: sub-schema equals the embedded-digest rule; violation rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE (T20-DRF-06)
const equals "1"; other value rejected XCOM-DECODE-VERSION (T20-DRF-07)

unit_cases.precondition: the domain separator and the two committed fixtures
unit_cases.stimulus: compare recorded/recomputed digests and canonical-body hashes with the goldens
unit_cases.expected: all equal the pinned golden values (T20-DRF-08)
exactly the accepted five forms; no sixth (T20-DRF-09)

static_checks.rule: cppcheck --error-exitcode=1 --quiet --std=c++20 --language=c++ --suppress=invalidLifetime src/xverse/xcom/src/activation_plan.cpp reports no error/portability defect in the consumed T019 decoder source built into the T020 suites

static_checks.tool: GNU g++ 11.4.0 via CMake target xverse_xcom_activation_plan_t020_<kind>_tests with xverse_xcom_apply_warnings
static_checks.rule: the T020 test target compiles under the project strict warning flags with no warning and no error
